name: Mara's Full Load Cache
hypothesis: Previous mandatory deposit rules failed because agents were forced to return with minimal loads (1 or 2 items), wasting the capacity of their 3-item storage and incurring high travel costs relative to food gained. The evidence shows that delaying the 'carrying' deposit trigger until the agent reaches full capacity (cargo=3) maximizes food per trip distance. By only forcing a return when the cargo count equals the maximum capacity (3), agents will accumulate more food before paying the energy penalty of travel, resulting in a higher net stored food count within the 720-step horizon.
